title: Fiqh of Salah: The Rulings & Proper Performance of Prayer
description: The fiqh of salah according to the Qur'an, authentic sunnah and understanding of the Salaf: who must pray, the opening conditions, how to pray as the Prophet (peace be upon him) prayed, the various ways to say the tashahhud, istikhara prayer, and khushu' (humility) in prayer. Sources: Newcastle Central Mosque (Al-Miftah fi al-Fiqh), Sheikh Assim al-Hakeem, and TROID.
short_description: Learn the fiqh of salah from the Qur'an and Sunnah

modules.title: Foundations: Prayer Is Your First Obligation
modules.description: Why salah matters and the conditions that must be met for it to be valid.

lessons.title: Why Prayer Is Your First Obligation
lessons.content: The obligation of the five daily prayers and why prayer comes before everything else in Islam. NCM: Al-Miftah fi al-Fiqh series.

lessons.title: The Conditions Most People Overlook
lessons.content: The conditions of salah that many people are unaware of - purity, covering, facing the qiblah, and time. NCM: Al-Miftah fi al-Fiqh series.

lessons.title: Are Our Prayers Really Valid?
lessons.content: What makes a prayer valid and what makes it invalid according to the Sunnah. NCM: Al-Miftah fi al-Fiqh series.

lessons.title: Are Your Prayers Valid?
lessons.content: A deeper look at validity: mistakes that invalidate salah and how to avoid them. NCM: Al-Miftah fi al-Fiqh series.

modules.title: The Prayer of the Prophet (ﷺ)
modules.description: How the Prophet prayed, from takbir to taslim, and related rulings.

lessons.title: The Prophet's Prayer ﷺ According to Authentic Ahadith
lessons.content: A complete description of the Prophet's prayer, based purely on authentic hadith: purification, standing, reciting, bowing, prostrating and sitting between the two sajdas. Sheikh Assim al-Hakeem.

lessons.title: The Various Ways to Say the Tashahhud
lessons.content: The authentic wordings of the tashahhud that were transmitted from the Prophet (peace be upon him). TROID.

lessons.title: How Should One Pray Salat al-Istikhara?
lessons.content: The istikhara prayer: its wording, etiquette and how to read the result and reach a decision. TROID.

modules.title: Khushu' in Salah
modules.description: The heart of salah: humility, presence and reverence.

lessons.title: The Heart of Salah is Khushu
lessons.content: khushu' (humility and presence) in prayer: what it means, why Allah asks for it, and how to attain it. NCM.
